sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य समेतास्तद्रणाजिरम् ।। ७.२२.१८ ॥
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।prajāpatiṁ puraskṛtya sametāstadraṇājiram ।। 7.22.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, a fierce battle ensued between Yama and the demon, both unyielding warriors desiring victory in their fight.
